faq.q1: How quickly can I get a response after contacting?
faq.a1: We typically respond within 2–4 hours during business hours. For urgent queries, WhatsApp or calling gets you the fastest response — usually within minutes.
faq.a2: Yes! Installation is simple and can be done by any local plumber. We provide a detailed installation guide and video support. For Pune and nearby areas, we also offer on-site installation assistance.
faq.a3: Absolutely. Our office at Ramtekadi Industrial Estate, Hadapsar is open Monday to Saturday. We recommend calling ahead so we can arrange a live product demonstration for you.
faq.q4: How do I know which model is right for me?
faq.a4: Just tell us your pipe diameter, material, approximate flow rate, and the type of application (domestic, agriculture, commercial, etc.). Our team will recommend the perfect Jaldoot unit for your setup.
